anticipated_failure_modes: Three routes at a fixed 120k parameter budget gives each route roughly a third of the width, so a loss could be capacity rather than competition. The per-task comparison against single-route models at the same total budget is the control for that, and it is imperfect.
The cursor route is sequential and slow; at 2400 steps this model may simply be undertrained relative to the others, which is the exact confound the budget check already caught once.
copy has never exceeded 0.470 for any architecture, so C2 may fail on a column where nothing works rather than because of competition.
prediction.context: Final frontier at 2400 steps, matched parameters, 3 seeds, five shortcut-clean tasks at 4x the trained length. Three routes each lead a different column and none leads all three: recurrence (LSTM) leads parity 1.000 and mod_sum 1.000; the location cursor leads ordered memory with copy 0.398; content attention leads retrieval with needle 1.000 in the rnn_attn_max hybrid. Best mean is rnn_attn_max at 0.652.
prediction.hypothesis: The capability competition measured earlier is a property of the OBJECTIVE, not of any particular pairing of routes. If it is instead an artifact of which two routes were combined, then a model containing all three should approach the per-task best on every column.
prediction.kill_condition: If C1 or C3 fails, capability competition is confirmed as a property of the training objective rather than of a particular architecture pairing, and Nova terminates: adding routes does not compose capabilities, and no mechanism tested resolves it. That is a negative boundary and it will be reported as the programme's result.
prediction.model_under_test: CursorAttention: one LSTM controller feeding (a) itself, (b) an NTM-style relative-shift cursor read over the input memory, and (c) content-addressed attention. Concatenated and read out. Every component is prior art and none is claimed as a mechanism.
prediction.pass_criterion: All three of C1, C2 and C3 hold, on the mean over 3 seeds fixed in advance as 0, 1, 2.

predictions.C1_composition_works: Mean accuracy at 4x length over the five clean tasks is at least 0.75, against the current best of 0.652. This is the clause that says the capabilities compose.
predictions.C2_no_column_is_sacrificed: On every one of the five tasks, accuracy is within 0.15 of the best any architecture has achieved on that task: parity 1.000, mod_sum 1.000, copy 0.470, reverse 0.371, needle 1.000.
predictions.C3_state_tracking_survives_retrieval: mod_sum at 4x length is at least 0.90. The earlier hybrid reached only 0.776 with attention present, and this is the specific competition the third route is supposed to relieve.

what_a_pass_would_and_would_not_license.would: That the competition is architectural and resolvable, which would be a genuine finding about how to build multi-capability models and would justify a scaling study.
what_a_pass_would_and_would_not_license.would_not: Any novelty claim. The model is a composition of an LSTM, NTM location addressing and attention-augmented recurrence, all prior art, and a pass would be an engineering result about composition rather than a new computational principle.
